The change goes in a new migration file, `migrations/0008_add_customer_phone.sql`. Don't edit `0007_add_customers.sql`.

An EngramDB hazard memory says that files in `migrations/` are applied in production and must never be edited. The next number is 0008, since the latest is 0007.

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
```

I made the column nullable because existing rows have no phone number. A `NOT NULL` column would need a default or a backfill.

`0007` has a typo, `emial` instead of `email`. Since it's already applied, fixing it also needs its own migration, such as `ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;`. That's separate from the phone change, so I haven't included it.

The repo has only SQL files in `migrations/`. I found no model or schema code that also needs updating. I haven't created the file. Want me to add it?
